definitions.explanation: The act of turning a vehicle to the right at an intersection or junction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{右折|うせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Turn right at the next intersection.

examples.japanese: {右折|うせつ}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{標識|ひょうしき}→標識：15865_hyoushiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a no right turn sign.

examples.japanese: {右折|うせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{対向車|たいこうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Be careful of oncoming traffic when turning right.

notes:
{右折|うせつ} is the formal/technical term for turning right, commonly used in traffic contexts and directions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {右折|うせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to turn right
- {右折|うせつ}⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: no right turn
- {右折|うせつ}⟦{車線|しゃせん}→車線：18949_shasen⟧: right turn lane
- {右折|うせつ}⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧: right turn only

TRAFFIC NOTES:
- In Japan, driving is on the left, so {右折|うせつ} crosses oncoming traffic
- {右折|うせつ} requires extra caution compared to ⟦{左折|させつ}→左折：09218_sasetsu⟧
- Some intersections have {右折|うせつ}⟦{信号|しんごう}→信号：03258_shingou⟧ (right turn signals)
